# Floor Boys

> > Floor Boys is a South Carolina flooring retailer offering in-home estimates, installation services, and a wide selection of carpet, vinyl plank, and hardwood products across Lexington, Columbia, Greenville, Chapin, and Florence.

Floor Boys specializes in both residential and commercial flooring solutions, featuring major brands like Mannington Adura Rigid and Stanton. The company serves multiple South Carolina locations with personalized consultation and professional installation services.

## Key Topics

- Floor Boys South Carolina
- In-home flooring estimates
- Vinyl plank flooring
- Mannington Adura Rigid
- Carpet products
- Hardwood flooring
- Residential and commercial installation
- Lexington, Columbia, Greenville locations
- Stanton carpet products
- Flooring installation services
- Kona Beach vinyl
- Dockside Sand flooring
- Chapin and Florence service areas
